The tallest lattice tower is the Tokyo Skytree, with a height of 634 metres (2,080 ft). The Petronius Compliant Tower is technically taller with a pinnacle height of 640 metres (2,100 ft) but is not universally recognized since most of that height is underwater. The city most renowned for lattice towers is Cincinnati, Ohio, which features four towers above 900 feet in height, Tokyo is the only other city in the world that has more than one above that height.
